status: exploratory simulation-only follow-up; frozen before predictor results
target: published binary-success-rate aggregate on unobserved base tasks for a held-out policy family
primary_cohort: non-agent, non-single-task entries with documented simulation training configurations in pinned website export
secondary_cohort: all non-agent, non-single-task entries; incomplete training/protocol provenance
tasks: 42 base tasks; randomized variants omitted entirely
metric: success_rate only; no progress or physical labels used
families: connected components of manually recorded named lineages and identical published initialization checkpoints; unknown relations remain a limitation
outer_validation: 3 grouped folds, 3 seeded partitions; both ranked policies must be held out in the same fold and belong to different family groups
anchors: 5 and 10 existing task means; 5 seeded uniform task orders shared by all policies, with nested 5/10 sets; no test-dependent selection
scale: least-squares nonnegative scalar fit to training task means using anchors; 0.01 ridge toward scale=1
latent: training-row task-centered SVD; anchor least squares; rank in [1,2,4], ridge in [0.01,0.1,1.0]; inner 3-fold family CV selects family-macro nonanchor MAE; ties favor smaller rank then larger ridge
primary_endpoint: family-macro MAE, after averaging tasks and repeated anchor/fold designs per policy then policies within family
ranking_endpoint: task-macro cross-family pair error for observed target success gaps >=0.10; predicted ties have 0.5 loss
diagnostics: nonzero-target MAE, zero-target MAE, anchor-set variation, task-wise pair coverage, descriptive cluster bootstrap intervals
bootstrap: 2000 draws of family clusters for MAE; task clusters for ranking; shared training and repeated measurements mean intervals remain descriptive
limits: known benchmark tasks, unseen predictor family groups with anchor observations; not unseen-task or real-world validation; denominators unavailable; no synthetic episodes
